clips.title: The story
paras: Johaan's Findings is a bundle of research documents penned by Apothecary Johaan in Brill. Entrusted to a courier heading south, these notes convey recent alchemical developments in Tirisfal Glades to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.

The Royal Apothecary Society operates under relentless pressure from Lady Sylvanas Windrunner to engineer a New Plague capable of destroying both the living and the Scourge. Because researchers are scattered across Lordaeron's contested ruins, maintaining a flow of data between outposts is vital. Apothecary Johaan compiles his local testing notes in Brill and dispatches them southward to Apothecary Renferrel, who directs society efforts from the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. These records represent one small piece of the Society's collective effort to hone their lethal brews.
